notes.title: Patch notes: V.2.0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/4504d830b2b91804344a03f256dff70cfd98a298.png[/img]

Hello, fans,

We have implemented emergency patches for the issues below.

1) Problem where the game stops at the warning page and does not proceed
2) Problem with some animations not being visible

Please update the game.

If any problems occur after the patch, please report it.

Thank you for loving Glass World.

notes.title: Memories of Glass Maiden released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/d37bab2a1ff6b608744fef5f4f6858378273dd1b.png[/img]

Hello, GLASS fans!

Since we launched the GLASS series, we've received a lot of requests from our fans.

One request stood out to us.
They wanted us to create a separate game where they could just enjoy the story and world of GLASS.

So we did! We made it! Memories of Glass Maiden!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2695960/Memories_of_Glass_Maiden/

Released today, Memories of the Glass Maiden (MOG) contains the story of GLASS 2.
We'll continue to update it with stories from GLASS 1 and private stories as well.

Please visit MOG when you want to immerse yourself in the GLASS world!

We look forward to seeing you in the future.

Thank you.

* MOG currently contains the story of GLASS 2. If you have already played GLASS 2, you don't need to purchase it now. We will notify you in the news when the new story is updated, so be sure to set your alarm~!

tags.feature: So we did! We made it! Memories of Glass Maiden!

notes.title: Update News (1.0.4d) : Goodbye~ Aaron!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44248961/ca8904c9382163e046d739bf2f9dfa290ee3ec14.png[/img]

In response to the opinions of everyone who loves Glass2, various updates have been made.

1. Goodbye~ Aaron!
In response to the opinion that the illustration of the male protagonist is burdensome, the graphics of Aaron, the male protagonist, have been drastically modified.
Feel free to rescue the heroines now!

2. Fix typos
Fixed the typos you reported.

3. Other updates
Adjusted the difficulty of some achievements.

4. Bug fixes
Fixed the bugs you found and reported.

We will continue to be a TSB that listens to your opinions.

Thank you.
